name: modernize-net-framework-wpf
prompt: Plan a staged migration of a large .NET Framework 4.8 WPF application to .NET 10 while preserving production behavior and keeping each change reviewable.
rubric: Establishes a reproducible baseline before changing the target framework.
Separates framework migration, package updates, architecture seams, and UI redesign into stages.
Defines rollback points, compatibility decisions, and Windows build/runtime validation.
